# King Street Dental & Medical

> Integrated medical and dental healthcare centre in Warrawong, Wollongong offering comprehensive services from general practice to specialist mental health care.

King Street Dental & Medical is a multi-disciplinary healthcare provider serving the Wollongong region, combining dental, medical, and allied health services in one convenient location. The clinic offers both preventive and cosmetic care with online booking through HotDoc.

- Dental Services
- Psychology & Mental Health
